snippet.title: Quarantine Zone | Zombie Research Overview Gameplay | Coming 2025
snippet.description:
Quarantine Zone keeps expanding on its path to launch later this year! Play the demo and wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419520/Quarantine_Zone_The_Last_Check/

The new Zombie Research video highlights the research projects and mechanics players will need to undergo un order to progress and work on a way out of this nightmare. 🧟‍♂️🔬🧑🏽‍🔬
